title: Add browser-facing /assets/[assetId] SvelteKit route
description: The Hono API at /api/bookmarks/:id/assets/:assetId works for app tokens but the SvelteKit UI has no /assets/[assetId] server route to stream favicons/previews/snapshots to the browser. The BookmarkCard and bundle preview pages can't emit tags for the bookmark's faviconKey or previewImageKey. Add src/routes/assets/[assetId]/+server.ts that: 1. Resolves the current user via hooks (browser session or API token) 2. Loads the asset + bookmark from D1 3. Enforces owner/shared/public access rules per the plan 4. Streams the R2 object with the right Content-Type and CSP 5. Supports ?download=1 to flip to attachment disposition Acceptance: a on a bookmark card renders the favicon for the owner, returns 404 for other users, and serves with the correct content-type + Cache-Control.

title: Fix Hono route ordering for /api/bookmarks
description:
In src/lib/server/hono.ts, bookmarksRouter is mounted at /api/bookmarks FIRST and singlefileRouter is mounted at /api/bookmarks SECOND. Today it works because bookmarksRouter's /:id only matches a single segment, but this is fragile — any future bookmarksRouter route like /:id/foo or /:id/assets would silently shadow the singlefile endpoint.

Either:
- Move both routes into a single router file
- Or mount the more-specific singlefileRouter first

Acceptance: POST /api/bookmarks/5/singlefile always reaches the singlefile handler, regardless of what new routes get added to bookmarksRouter. Add a regression test in test/unit/api-routing.test.ts that POSTs to that path and asserts the response.

title: Wire queue consumer into Worker entry point
description:
src/jobs/queue-consumer.ts exports handleQueueBatch(batch, env) but the SvelteKit-generated _worker.js only exports a default fetch handler. Cloudflare Workers need a named 'queue' export to receive messages.

Build a custom worker entry at src/worker.ts (or a thin wrapper) that:
1. Imports the SvelteKit-generated fetch handler from .svelte-kit/cloudflare/_worker.js
2. Re-exports default fetch (or wraps it)
3. Adds a queue export that calls handleQueueBatch(batch, env)
4. Update wrangler.jsonc main to point at the new entry (or use the hooks mechanism)

Acceptance: a manual 'wrangler dev' with a produced message hits handleQueueBatch, and a deploy to Cloudflare processes a real enqueued message end-to-end.

title: Fix Cloudflare Browser Rendering REST call in snapshot.ts
description:
src/jobs/handlers/snapshot.ts hard-codes the API URL 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/snapshot' and '.../pdf'. The actual Browser Rendering REST API uses '/accounts/{account_id}/browser-rendering/snapshot' and requires the account ID.

More importantly, the 'browser' binding on Cloudflare Workers is a Fetcher that supports RPC-style methods like browser.fetch(...) for plain HTTP, and a custom binding protocol for screenshots, snapshots, and PDF. The current code uses an HTTP path that may not exist on the Fetcher.

Two fixes:
1. Read CF_ACCOUNT_ID from env and build the correct REST URL '/accounts/{id}/browser-rendering/{snapshot|pdf}'
2. Or, more idiomatically, use the Fetcher's RPC methods if available — for a Worker binding, that's browser.fetch(request) where request hits a known internal path

Verify by deploying and testing. Document the working approach in a code comment and update DEPLOYMENT.md.

Acceptance: snapshot job successfully captures an HTML page via the browser binding on a real Cloudflare deployment, stores the gzipped result in R2, and sets latest_snapshot_asset_id on the bookmark.

title: Add --postgres-url support to migrate-linkding tool
description:
tools/migrate-linkding.ts currently only supports --sqlite. The plan explicitly says 'Inputs: --sqlite /path/to/db.sqlite3 or --postgres-url'.

Add a --postgres-url <url> branch:
1. Use the 'pg' npm package (devDependency)
2. Connect, run the same SELECT statements adapted to Postgres
3. Feed the result rows into the existing toExportBookmarks + exportNetscape / JSON output
4. Make --sqlite and --postgres-url mutually exclusive in --help output
5. Add a unit test in test/unit/migrate-linkding.test.ts that mocks pg.Client and asserts the right SQL is sent

Acceptance: with a running Linkding Postgres instance, the tool produces an export identical in shape to the SQLite path (modulo timestamp formats).

title: Add Playwright e2e tests
description:
Phase 10 acceptance criteria explicitly call for Playwright e2e tests. cloudflare/test/e2e/ exists but is empty. Add:
1. playwright.config.ts targeting a wrangler dev or local preview environment
2. e2e/auth.spec.ts: mock the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header in a test bypass, sign in, land on /bookmarks
3. e2e/bookmarks.spec.ts: create / edit / archive / delete a bookmark via the UI
4. e2e/search.spec.ts: type a search, click a tag chip, verify the URL updates
5. e2e/bulk.spec.ts: select 2 cards, choose Archive from the bulk bar, assert they move
6. e2e/api-token.spec.ts: create a token, use it to GET /api/bookmarks/, assert 200
7. e2e/import.spec.ts: upload a known Netscape fixture, assert counts
8. Add npm scripts: test:e2e, test:e2e:install
9. Add a test/fixtures/bookmarks-netscape.html with a tiny known export

Acceptance: npm run test:e2e passes against a wrangler dev instance using a freshly applied migration and a single dev user.

title: Phase 4: Core UI - bookmarks pages, new/edit, details modal
description: Phase 4 of AGENTS.md: SvelteKit pages for active/archived/shared bookmarks; new/edit bookmark form actions; details modal; tag cloud with selected tag add/remove; sorting, filters, pagination; theme and profile display preferences.
design: SvelteKit form actions for create/edit/delete. +page.server.ts loaders that query D1 with the compiled search SQL. Components: BookmarkList, BookmarkCard, BookmarkDetailsModal, TagCloud, FilterDrawer. Match current app UX, no visual redesign.

title: Phase 3: REST API compatibility (Hono)
description: Phase 3 of AGENTS.md: implement bookmark, tag, bundle, asset, and user profile API endpoints via Hono subrouter. DRF-compatible pagination shape ({count, next, previous, results}). 'Token' and 'Bearer' auth. Permission boundaries (owner-only, owner+shared, public). Tests cover documented examples.
design: Hono routers in src/server/api/ mounted under /api/. Routes match linkding docs: GET/POST /api/bookmarks/, GET /api/bookmarks/:id/, PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/bookmarks/:id/, /api/bookmarks/:id/archive/, /unarchive/, /singlefile/, /check/, asset routes, /api/tags/, /api/bundles/, /api/user/profile/.

title: Phase 2: Cloudflare Access auth + API token auth + CSRF
description: Phase 2 of AGENTS.md: Access JWT validation middleware in src/auth/access-jwt.ts; user/profile upsert on first login; admin email config via ADMIN_EMAILS; app session cookie with HMAC CSRF token for state-changing UI actions; API token creation/hashing/revoke/rotate; accept both 'Authorization: Token ...' and 'Authorization: Bearer ...' for API routes. Public shared routes do not create user sessions.
design: Issue an app session cookie after Access validation with HMAC(APP_SECRET, sessionId + userId + dayBucket) as the CSRF token. Validate Origin/Host on mutations. API routes: bypass Access, require app bearer/Token. Strict mode: Access Service Auth + app token.

title: Phase 1: Port auto-tagging rules with tests
description: cloudflare/src/domain/auto-tagging.ts: parse and apply auto-tagging rules against a bookmark URL/title. Each rule: match pattern (substring/regex on url or title) -> tags to add. Stored in user_profile.auto_tagging_rules as JSON text.
design: Pure module. Rules parsed once per request, cached in profile. Output is a deduplicated string array of tag names.
acceptance_criteria: Functions: parseAutoTaggingRules(json), applyAutoTagging(rules, {url, title}). Tests cover: substring match on url, regex match, multiple rules accumulating tags, no-match returning empty, invalid rule JSON handled gracefully.

title: Phase 1: Port search query parser with tests
description: cloudflare/src/domain/search-parser.ts porting the Linkding search query grammar. Tokens: bareword, #tag, !unread, !untagged, quoted phrases, and/or/not binary operators, parentheses. Output an AST suitable for a SQL compiler.
design: Tokenizer produces tokens; Pratt-style parser builds AST. AST nodes: Term(text|tag|keyword), And, Or, Not, Group. Pure module, no D1 imports.
acceptance_criteria: Parser returns typed AST. Tests cover: simple words, AND/OR/NOT precedence (AND binds tighter than OR), parenthesized groups, quoted phrases with spaces, #tag tokens, !unread and !untagged, strict/lax mode flag passthrough, legacy mode flag passthrough, empty input.

title: Phase 1: Port tag parsing/building with tests
description: cloudflare/src/domain/tags.ts implementing Linkding tag helpers: splitTags(input), normalizeTagName(name) (lowercase + collapse spaces + hyphenate), parseTagString(value) (space/comma separated, allow leading #), buildTagSearchFragment(tags) for query DSL, compareTagNames for equality.
design: Pure functions only. No IO. Tags compared in normalized form for uniqueness.
acceptance_criteria: Functions: splitTags, normalizeTagName, parseTagString, buildTagSearchFragment, compareTagNames. Tests cover: case insensitivity, spaces to hyphens, leading # stripping, multiple separators, empty input, duplicates dedup.

title: Phase 1: Port URL normalization with tests
description: cloudflare/src/domain/url-normalize.ts implementing Linkding-style URL normalization: strip default ports, lowercase host, drop trailing slash on path root, drop fragment, strip common tracking query params, sort remaining query params, percent-encode path safely. Plus Vitest tests covering the spec.
design: Pure function, no IO. Compare-by-parsing. Output a URL string and a separate 'display' form for UI when needed.
acceptance_criteria: normalizeUrl(input) function; suite of unit tests covering: scheme casing, default port stripping, host lowercasing, root path slash drop, fragment removal, tracking-param drop (utm_*, fbclid, gclid), query param sorting, idempotency. All tests pass via npm test.

title: Phase 1: Drizzle schema definitions matching SQL
description: Author cloudflare/src/db/schema.ts with Drizzle table definitions for users, user_profiles, bookmarks, tags, bookmark_tags, bookmark_assets, bookmark_bundles, api_tokens, feed_tokens, toasts, global_settings. Columns and types match the SQL migration 1:1.
design: Use sqliteTable from drizzle-orm/sqlite-core. INTEGER booleans via integer({ mode: 'boolean' }). Export inferred row types per table.
acceptance_criteria: schema.ts compiles; column types mirror SQL (integers, text, defaults); no SQL string concatenation anywhere; drizzle-kit not required for runtime; ts type DrizzleInfer selects are usable by repositories.

title: Phase 1: D1 SQL migrations for core schema
description: Write SQL migration files under cloudflare/migrations/ for: users, user_profiles, bookmarks, tags, bookmark_tags, bookmark_assets, bookmark_bundles, api_tokens, feed_tokens, toasts, global_settings. Include all indexes from AGENTS.md.
design: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY for entity tables; TEXT for timestamps stored as ISO 8601 UTC. Bookmarks: unique (owner_id, url_normalized), index (owner_id, is_archived, date_added DESC), (owner_id, date_modified DESC), (shared, owner_id). Tags: unique (owner_id, name_normalized), index (owner_id, name). bookmark_assets: index (bookmark_id, date_created DESC), (status, date_created).
acceptance_criteria: 0001_init.sql with all core tables and indexes; applies cleanly with wrangler d1 migrations apply --local; Drizzle schema (separate issue) maps 1:1 to columns.

title: Phase 0: Author wrangler.jsonc with local/preview/production envs
description: Checked-in wrangler config with placeholder bindings for D1, R2, Queue, DLQ, Browser, Workflows, and Access vars. Provide env.local (default), env.preview, env.production with separate D1 db ids, R2 buckets, queue names, AUD values. Compatibility flags and date set. Documented as the deployment source of truth.
design: Use run_worker_first for app routes so SvelteKit handlers run before static asset fallback. Name buckets/queues with -preview/-prod suffix in the env overrides.
acceptance_criteria: wrangler.jsonc valid; wrangler types runs and produces src/worker-configuration.d.ts; separate env.preview and env.production sections present; D1, R2, queues (producers + consumers + DLQ), browser, workflows entries present; access vars (ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN, ACCESS_AUD, ADMIN_EMAILS) in vars; placeholder ids used in envs and called out.

title: Phase 0: Scaffold SvelteKit + Hono app under cloudflare/
description: Initialize the cloudflare/ subfolder with SvelteKit on Cloudflare Workers, Hono for /api/* subrouter, TypeScript strict mode, package.json scripts, base config. AGENTS.md Phase 0 deliverable. Keep the existing repo (Django reference) untouched at the root.
design: SvelteKit on Workers (adapter-cloudflare) for UI; Hono mounted under src/server/hono.ts and reachable from a SvelteKit server endpoint at /api/[...path]/+server.ts. Domain code stays pure (no CF imports) under src/domain/.
acceptance_criteria: cloudflare/ folder exists with SvelteKit config, src/ with app.html, hooks.server.ts, routes/+layout.*, package.json with dev/build/test/typecheck/lint scripts, tsconfig with strict mode, svelte.config.js using @sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare, vite.config.ts. Wrangler dev starts cleanly.
notes: No Django source present in this repo, so URL/tag/search logic is implemented to match behavior described in AGENTS.md. Phase 0 + 1 only per handoff prompt at end of AGENTS.md.

title: Surface friendly duplicate_url error from edit form
description:
The edit page (src/routes/bookmarks/[bookmarkId]/edit/+page.svelte) handles form?.error === 'duplicate_url' with a friendly message, but the server action in +page.server.ts doesn't actually return the 'duplicate_url' string when DuplicateUrlError is thrown — it returns fail(400, { error: ... }) where ... comes from the error message.

Trace: updateBookmark in bookmarks.repo.ts throws new DuplicateUrlError(); the catch block in the edit form action currently propagates a generic message.

Fix:
1. In the edit form action, catch DuplicateUrlError explicitly and return fail(400, { error: 'duplicate_url' })
2. Verify the Svelte template branch triggers
3. Add a unit test for the error shape

Acceptance: editing a bookmark to a URL that another bookmark of the same owner uses shows the friendly 'Another bookmark already uses this URL.' message instead of a stack trace.

title: Decide and document createBookmark upsert semantics
description:
The plan says 'Keep create behavior where duplicate URL updates existing bookmark for now' but the current code in createBookmark() just returns the existing record without updating any fields. That doesn't match the documented behavior.

Pick one and document:
- Option A: create() returns the existing record untouched (idempotent insert semantics)
- Option B: create() merges new fields into the existing record and returns it (upsert semantics)

The Linkding REST API uses Option B for compatibility. Switch the implementation to match by:
1. Adding an upsert field in CreateBookmarkInput that says which fields to overwrite
2. If URL exists, call updateBookmark() with the supplied fields
3. Always return 200 (not 201) on duplicate, 201 on new
4. Document the behavior in docs/RUNBOOK.md or a new docs/API.md

Acceptance: POST /api/bookmarks/ with a duplicate URL updates the title, description, notes, and tags, returns 200 with the merged record. Tests in test/unit/create-bookmark.test.ts cover both new and duplicate paths.

title: Plan and implement public sharing on a separate hostname
description:
The plan calls for two hostnames: app.example.com (private, behind Access) and share.example.com (public, for shared bookmarks/feeds/assets). Currently everything is on one host with policy bypasses.

Decide and document the routing model:
1. Should share.example.com run the same Worker or a separate Worker?
2. How do shared-only assets serve without leaking owner IDs in URLs?
3. What's the Cloudflare Access policy shape?

Decisions to make:
- Same-worker, hostname-conditional: Worker reads request.hostname and serves public routes only from share.*; rest get 404
- Separate Worker: cleaner but doubles deployment surface

Recommendation: same-worker hostname check. Add a publicAssetsRouter mounted at /public/* that only serves bookmark_assets where shared=1 AND owner_enable_public_sharing=1, with bookmark_assets.r2_key fetched but the response never contains owner_id.

Add the hostname check in hooks.server.ts so SvelteKit + Hono both respect it. Add an admin-only flag in global_settings to toggle public sharing on/off per deployment.

Acceptance: deploy to share.example.com, hit /public/assets/{id} for a publicly-shared asset, get the bytes. Hit /api/bookmarks on share.example.com, get 404. Hit /public/assets/{id} for a non-public asset, get 403.

title: Replace wrangler.jsonc placeholders for first remote deploy
description:
cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc still contains three placeholders that block a real production deploy:
1. The 'database_id' in the production env is 'replace-me' — must be the ID from 'wrangler d1 create cloudpin-prod'
2. ACCESS_AUD is 'replace-me' in vars — must be the Access application audience tag
3. queue_name suffixes are -local / -preview / -prod and rely on the operator pre-creating them

Document the wrangler setup commands in docs/RUNBOOK.md (already partially done — verify and complete) and add a tools/bootstrap.sh that runs the create-bucket / create-db / create-queue commands in idempotent form. The script should print the IDs it created so they can be pasted back into wrangler.jsonc.

Acceptance: running the bootstrap script against a fresh Cloudflare account creates the named resources and the operator can paste the IDs in one shot to make the production env deployable.

title: Build search SQL compiler from parsed AST
description: Convert a SearchNode AST (from src/domain/search-parser.ts) into a parameterized SQL WHERE clause. Supports term, tag, keyword, AND, OR, NOT, group. Output: { sql: string, params: unknown[] }. Used by bookmark list queries.
design: Recursively build a string with placeholder params. Tags via EXISTS subquery on bookmark_tags. Special keywords (!unread, !untagged) via direct column checks. Use LIKE for terms initially; switch to FTS5 in a follow-up.
notes: Pre-req for Phase 3 (API list) and Phase 4 (UI bookmarks page).

title: Phase 7: R2 assets and async jobs
description: Phase 7 of AGENTS.md: favicon fetch to R2; preview image fetch with size/type checks; asset upload/download/view/delete; queue consumer with retries and DLQ; backfill jobs for favicons/previews.
design: Queue messages: discriminated union with Zod. Handlers idempotent, skip missing bookmarks. R2 keys under storage/asset-keys.ts. Asset routes: ownership check, shared/public rules per AGENTS.md R2 section.

title: Phase 6: Settings, feeds, PWA, import/export
description: Phase 6 of AGENTS.md: general settings form; integrations page (API tokens, feed token rotation, bookmarklet URLs); Netscape export; Netscape import workflow; RSS/Atom feeds; PWA manifest; OpenSearch XML; custom CSS route.
design: Use src/domain/feeds.ts for XML generation. Import: stage uploaded HTML to R2, queue import job, parse, batch create bookmarks with tags. Export: stream generated HTML with proper Content-Disposition.

title: Phase 5: Tags, bundles, bulk actions
description: Phase 5 of AGENTS.md: tag index/search/sort/unused; tag create/edit/delete/merge; bundle create/edit/delete/reorder/preview; bulk archive/unarchive/delete/tag/untag/read/unread/share/unshare/refresh/snapshot.
design: Tag merge: load all bookmarks with source tag, reassign to target, delete source. Bundle preview: run compiled search SQL with bundle filters. Bulk actions: form action with multi-select state, repository batch methods.

title: Phase 1: README with local dev commands
description: cloudflare/README.md explaining: prerequisites (Node 20+, Wrangler), install, dev (wrangler dev), typecheck, test, db:migrate:local, db:migrate:remote:preview, db:migrate:remote:prod, build, deploy. Section on the directory layout and where domain code lives.
acceptance_criteria: README has all listed scripts matching package.json; explains D1/R2/Queue/Workflow placeholder ids need replacement for real deploys; links to AGENTS.md for the full plan.

title: Phase 0: CI workflow (typecheck/lint/test/build)
description: GitHub Actions workflow files: ci.yml on PRs (typecheck, lint, test, build) and deploy.yml on main (typecheck, lint, test, build, wrangler d1 migrations apply, wrangler deploy --env production). Uses CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secrets.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/deploy.yml exist; ci runs on pull_request; deploy runs on push to main; both run npm ci then typecheck/lint/test/build. Deploy also runs wrangler d1 migrations apply and wrangler deploy. Secrets referenced but not committed.
notes: Local-only repo for now (no remote). Workflows kept checked in so they're ready when remote is added.

title: Phase 10: Hardening (Playwright e2e, security, runbooks)
description: Phase 10 of AGENTS.md: Playwright e2e for core workflows; API contract tests; security tests for private/shared/public assets; structured logs; production deploy runbook; backup/restore runbook.

title: Phase 9: Migration from existing Linkding
description: Phase 9 of AGENTS.md: Netscape import path documented; direct migration tool supports SQLite at minimum; dry-run reports counts; migration verification command; cutover checklist.
design: tools/migrate-linkding.ts reads SQLite via better-sqlite3 (or postgres via pg), inserts into D1 via wrangler d1 execute. File migration: stream data/ assets/favicons/previews to R2 with same key shape.

title: Phase 8: Archiving and snapshots
description: Phase 8 of AGENTS.md: Wayback snapshot queue job; browser SingleFile upload route; Snapshot Workflow creates pending/complete/failure asset rows; PDF snapshot path with max size; Browser Rendering HTML snapshot path.
design: Workflow class SnapshotWorkflow in src/workflows/snapshot-workflow.ts. Steps: HEAD content-type, fetch up to limit, gzip, R2 put, update asset + bookmark. Reuse Phase 7 queue for backfill messages.
